verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes official API spec files in its stripe/openapi GitHub repository, and the README says to "use these files to generate SDKs or client libraries," so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe found nothing at conventional docs-domain paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json), which hurts discoverability but does not contradict that the GitHub spec exists. Missing for 10: discovery at standard well-known or docs-domain URLs, first-party docs describing the spec's format, versions and coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation of downloading and using the spec.
